tools.name: book_event
tools.description: Submit a request to book Rick Hebert for an event. This sends the details to Rick, who personally reviews every request and replies (usually within a day) to confirm availability, pricing, and details — it does NOT instantly confirm or hold a date. Collect the contact's name and at least an email or phone number before calling. Rick is based near Houston, TX and travels for the right event.

name.description: Full name of the person booking.

email.description: Contact email address. Provide this and/or a phone number.

phone.description: Contact phone number. Provide this and/or an email.

contact_pref.description: How they'd prefer Rick to reach back — e.g. 'email', 'phone', or 'text'.

event_type.description: The occasion — e.g. wedding, corporate event, birthday party, holiday party, gala, fundraiser.

event_date.description: Event date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit or leave blank if not set yet.

event_city.description: City and/or venue. Rick is based near Houston, TX (Greater Houston: The Woodlands, Sugar Land, Galveston, Clear Lake) and travels for the right event.

guest_count.description: Approximate number of guests, e.g. '50' or '75-100'.

format.description: Preferred format, if known: 'Strolling Close-Up', 'The Stand-Up Show', or 'The Full Evening'. See list_packages. Omit if unsure — Rick will recommend.

message.description: Anything else about the event or what they're looking for.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List Rick Hebert's three booking formats (each custom-quoted): Strolling Close-Up, The Stand-Up Show, and The Full Evening. Use to help a user choose a format before booking.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get Rick Hebert's contact details (phone, email) and the area he serves. Use when the user wants to reach Rick directly or asks where he performs.
